description:
Earn 15% Commission + 180-Day Cookie + Professional Marketing Resources

Join the KC Hardware Affiliate Program and earn commissions promoting premium door, window, shower door, and replacement hardware products trusted by homeowners, contractors, property managers, maintenance professionals, and remodeling companies across the United States.

Affiliate Resources:
Approved affiliates receive access to our official Affiliate Media Kit, including banners, logos, product images, promotional materials, and marketing resources designed to help maximize conversions and affiliate earnings.

Affiliate Media Kit:
https://kchardware.us/pages/affiliate-media-kit

How Affiliates Earn:
Earn 15% commission on every qualified sale generated through your unique affiliate links. Affiliates receive a 180-day tracking cookie, promotional materials, banners, and marketing resources to maximize conversions.

About KC Hardware:
KC Hardware is a trusted supplier of premium door, window, shower door, and replacement hardware products serving homeowners, contractors, property managers, maintenance professionals, and remodeling companies throughout the United States.

What Makes Us Different:
We offer high-quality replacement parts, competitive pricing, fast shipping, excellent customer service, and a growing catalog of hard-to-find hardware solutions. Customers choose KC Hardware because we help them repair, maintain, and improve their properties with reliable products.

How to Promote KC Hardware:
Affiliates may promote KC Hardware through websites, blogs, social media channels, YouTube videos, email marketing, paid advertising, review websites, and other approved marketing methods.

Additional Information:
All affiliate applications are manually reviewed to maintain a high-quality affiliate network. Approved affiliates receive ongoing support and access to official marketing materials.
payout_period: Affiliate commissions are reviewed and paid monthly. Payments are typically issued between the 15th and 20th of each month after order verification and approval.
